caption: A putted golf ball rolls across the green, hits the back of the cup's rim, pops up, and drops into the hole.

sa.check: A putted golf ball rolls across a green.
It hits the back of the cup's rim.
It strikes the far side of the rim rather than dropping straight in.
The roll comes first, then the rim, then the pop up, then the drop in.

pc.expect: The hop begins where the ball meets the far rim, and it is a short hop rather than a long flight.
pc.fail: The ball pops up before it reaches the cup; or it is flung high across the green at the rim; or it rolls over the hole with no change of motion at all.

pc.expect: After the hop the ball falls back down and drops below the level of the green into the hole.
pc.fail: The ball hangs above the cup after the hop; or it rises away from the hole and keeps rising; or it settles on top of the hole as if the opening were solid ground.

pc.expect: The ball enters the cup through its opening; the turf and the rim stay solid.
pc.fail: The ball passes through the turf beside the hole; or it sinks into the green where there is no hole; or it passes through the edge of the rim rather than over it.

pc.expect: The ball stays a hard sphere and the turf and the rim stay firm where it touches them.
pc.fail: The ball squashes at the rim and stays squashed; or the turf ripples like cloth as the ball rolls over it; or the rim bends where the ball strikes it.

pc.expect: One ball and one hole are there throughout.
pc.fail: The ball vanishes before reaching the cup or a second one appears; or a second hole appears on the green; or the ball turns into another object.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The ball's colour, the flag and the green stay the same.
pc.fail: The ball changes colour as it rolls; or the hole moves to a different part of the green between frames; or the surroundings of the green rearrange.
